text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: Section four is run! Anchors circling! In lead, Kitasan Black from Team!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (Bakushin O-san handed lead to me!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (Bike section was brutal... Even on least suitable route, she cleared long course in first place!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (Me too... Won't ever give up! Nothing I can't overcome!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Kitasan's speeding up! If gap widens more, she might escape...!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: No! Climax approaches! She shall perform dramatic final act!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: She'll stop her! Bright will definitely follow through!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: (...Tannhauser said she has stamina plus finishing kick. Letting gap widen makes this harder.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: (Holding pace is risky too... Then...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: (Bright-chan making move...! Bit early, but won't let her...!)

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright and Narita Top Road pick up pace! Gap shrinking bit by bit!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (Coming fast...! From behind...!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ha... ha... ha... ha, ha, ha, haaah!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I'll catch her! Pull right ahead!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: (Must run proud for Opera O-chan, Doto-chan, and Ayabe-san who put faith in me!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: (To claim victory for Ryan Onee-sama!)

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Toryaaa! Hyaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright and Narita Top Road closing in! Can they reach Kitasan Black?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (Run, run, run-run-run! Faster! To goal...!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (I'm breaking away!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black pulls away again! Will chasers reach, or can she break free?!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black escapes across finish line! First place, Kitasan Black! Victory is hers!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: Team wins Tracen Academy Team Triathlon Tournament!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Bright, tough luck out there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes. Top crown must wait until next time.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh? Bright-san, look kinda cheerful?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...Felt weak before tourney started.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Frustrating, but... almost reached top!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Polishing basics built more strength than expected...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Felt results firsthand, huh? Good stuff!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes! Special Week-sama, Matikane Tannhauser-sama, thank you dearly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Practice, race day both... couldn't have done without you two.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: No no...! Didn't do anything big, really...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan gave awesome start, and Tannhauser-san's drink gave real boost!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, so glad~! Gained courage and confidence from this team too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Training and racing together was huge fun, desu_ne!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Care for lunch at Mejiro estate after? We can arrange buffet~♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Good race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Good race. Fell short at end...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: All my fault, sorry! Ayabe-san brought us top spot and I tripped right over, auuuu!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Wait, Doto-chan, not your fault! Bad wording on my part, sorry!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Precisely! We ignited crowd! Even earned special prize as proof!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Splendid performance for interlude!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Main act shall ignite stage with even grander fervor!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Right!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Only this once, please.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Fate's goddess alone knows! Until next time, ciao!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A-Ah, Opera O-san, wait up~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: (...Want to stand beside everyone. From now on too.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: (More than anyone—want to beat everyone next time!)

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Kitasan, Satono! Congrats on win! Amazing beating upperclassmen~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, told you, never know until you try!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: Both so awesome... Watched and started crying...!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Got so much courage from you two! Keeping challenger spirit close from now on!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whoa, huge run, Kita-chan! Peak comedy, pure hype, best race ever!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Splendid dash! True triumph of sheer passion and speed!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah... thank you so much...! Was just running in pure daze...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Passion fired soul up! Now hoist torso high! Classmates over there, join victory march!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Fufu, whole class mobbed you. Nice getting celebrated, right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah! ...Just recalled that spark from first time seeing Teio-san race.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Teio-san's running gave me courage. Made me want to run just like that.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: One step closer to dream then?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Even with big help from seniors! Got tons of courage from them!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Next time, want to inspire others myself. Want my running to bring smiles across Tracen Academy, just like Teio-san, Dad, and everyone else!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: And want to run with everyone again!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone includes me too, right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Course! Let's race together!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Special Week: "Mom, Tracen Academy really is incredible place, desu_ne."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "So many amazing girls to run with! Road to top is tough, but super exciting!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "Can't lose to anyone. I'm gonna be best Uma Musume in Japan!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Alright! Bring it on—!
